title: Viewport-aware sampled rendering for time-series with accessible hover/focus fallbacks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: High-density timeseries (100k+ points) cause janky interactions, large memory for KV cache previews, and noisy screen-reader output when every point is announced. Goals: (1) reduce render and memory cost for high-density traces by using viewport-aware sampling and incremental canvas tiles, (2) provide deterministic, accessible hover/focus summaries (rather than point-by-point aria announcements), (3) preserve precise hover for zoomed-in ranges and keyboard navigation, and (4) surface telemetry and safe rollout gates to detect regressions. Scope: design changes to chart component API, legend/tooltip behavior, aria summaries, and default token recommendations for high-density modes.
acceptance_criteria: Viewport sampling enabled by default for traces > 50k points with opt-out prop (chart.sampleStrategy = 'viewport'|'full'|'decimate')
Visual fidelity maintained at zoom >= 1s/window: sampling switches to full precision for active viewport
Hover/keyboard focus announces compact summaries via aria-live: series name, aggregated metric (min/avg/max) for hovered pixel column
Legend toggles remain precise and reflect sampled data but show a ‘precise on zoom’ hint
Perf regression gate: no more than 10% increase in 95th p99 render latency in canary region, and memory for charts reduced by >=40% for tested traces
Unit tests + a11y e2e tests covering Screen Reader output and keyboard pan/zoom
design_decisions: Use reservoir-style sampling per pixel column to preserve outliers while limiting points drawn
Render on an off-main Worklet + incremental canvas tiling to keep main thread responsive; fallback to SVG only for <2000 points
Tooltips: switch to a clustered-summary tooltip for sampled columns; on precise mode (zoomed or ctrl-key) show nearest-point tooltip
Use aria-live polite region to announce compact summaries, not individual points; provide a keyboard-only detailed mode via Enter
Expose config tokens: charts.sampleThreshold, charts.tileSizePx, charts.samplingMode to let platform teams tune defaults
qa_checks: Large-trace smoke: load 200k sample trace and verify chart stays interactive under 200ms median frame time
A11y: VoiceOver/NVDA verify aria-live summary reads once per hover and keyboard focus announces aggregated numbers
Keyboard: left/right pan advances by column; Enter toggles detailed point announcement; test with 3 screen readers
Visual: compare PNG diff of zoomed-in region between sampled mode and full-render to ensure no visual regression >= 95% PSNR
Telemetry: ensure charting telemetry emits sampleMode, tileCount, drawCalls for each page view
comments: 2026-02-10 Aisha Patel: Initial PRD and goals posted. Noted overlap with ENG-40122 (render pipeline refactor). Requesting ENG & PM sync.
2026-02-18 Marco Liu: Engineering prefers reservoir sampling per-column to preserve spikes. Will prototype tiling with OffscreenCanvas in a Worklet; flagged Safari fallback risk.
2026-02-21 Priya Desai (A11y): Recommend aria summary format: 'Series X: avg 12.3, min 1.0, max 98.2 over visible range' and avoid per-point reads. Suggested keyboard Enter for detailed read.
2026-02-28 Design review: Accepted clustered tooltip approach. Action: produce Figma prototype and micro-interaction spec for tooltip expand/collapse.
2026-03-04 Engineering prototype: Off-main tiling reduces main-thread time by ~60% on MacBook M1 in local tests. Safari fallback uses SVG tiling which increases memory; added canary flag.

2026-03-08 Accessibility audit: Need focus ring contrast for sampled hit areas and visible focus target for keyboard-only users. Updated tokens request: charts.focusStrokeWidth and charts.focusContrastToken.
2026-03-12 Marco Liu: Merged feature branch to canary; observability dashboard added. Next: address Safari 14 path and finalize rollout plan.
notes: Rollout plan: feature flag + canary region (eu-west-1), monitor p95 render latency and SR feedback for 72h, then gradual ramp to 25% then 100%
Tuning guidance: recommend charts.sampleThreshold = 50000, charts.tileSizePx = 1024 for general workloads; platform teams may lower threshold for low-power devices
Design tokens to add: charts.samplingIndicatorColor, charts.focusStrokeWidth, charts.samplingModeBadge (text and bg tokens)
